@@U04457@@
Sea and shore are at peace. The sea welcomes your rapid ships from shore, and standing here at your palace you can say with pride that all the world is encompassed by your arms’ embrace. And where else did it start but here? The first rude hut, a tiny scratch of a ditch to the sea, where today your oars splash lustily in the waves. Your noble purpose and the industry of your men have won the rewards of earth and sea. Standing here—

@@U04459@@
Yes, and it’s that ere, that ere that so oppresses me! I confess it to you, you who are so wise in the ways of the world, it cuts me to the very heart, to my heart’s core, making it impossible to bear! And how it shames me to say it! They, up there, the old couple, they'll have to go. I want those lindens, want them for myself, to sit under. Those trees, those few trees, those trees that are not my trees, destroy it all, my worldwide possessions. In those trees I want to build platforms, great platforms from branch to branch, a place to stand and see the totality of all that I have accomplished, to survey at one glance this masterpiece of the human mind that raises from the sea new land for humans to live on. This is the bitterest torment of all, to suffer for the little one doesn’t own.
translation:
@@U04457@@
大海和海岸都很平静。大海在岸上欢迎您的快速船只，站在您的宫殿里，您可以自豪地说，整个世界都被您的双臂拥抱着。除了这里之外，它还能从哪里开始呢？第一个简陋的小屋，是通往大海的一条小沟渠，今天你的桨在海浪中猛烈地拍打。你们崇高的宗旨和你们人民的勤奋赢得了大地和海洋的回报。站在这里——

@@U04459@@
是的，就是这个，那个，让我如此压抑！我向你坦白，你这个深谙人情世故的人，这件事刺痛了我的心，刺痛了我的心，让我无法承受！说出来我是多么羞愧啊！他们，上面那对老夫妇，他们得走了。我想要那些椴树，想要它们属于我自己，坐在下面。那些树，那些为数不多的树，那些不是我的树的树，全部毁掉，我在全世界的财产。我想在这些树上建造平台，从一个树枝到另一个树枝的伟大平台，一个可以站立并看到我所取得的全部成就的地方，一眼就能看到这个人类思想的杰作，它从海洋中升起了人类赖以生存的新土地。这是最痛苦的折磨，为不属于自己的小孩子而受苦。
